message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: "postgres"
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "postgres"
  POSTGRES_DB: "wordsmith"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-init
  namespace: wordsmith
data:
  db.words.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE nouns (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE verbs (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE adjectives (word TEXT NOT NULL);

    INSERT INTO nouns(word) VALUES
      ('cloud'),
      ('elephant'),
      ('gø language'),
      ('laptøp'),
      ('cøntainer'),
      ('micrø-service'),
      ('turtle'),
      ('whale'),
      ('gøpher'),
      ('møby døck'),
      ('server'),
      ('bicycle'),
      ('viking'),
      ('mermaid'),
      ('fjørd'),
      ('legø'),
      ('flødebolle'),
      ('smørrebrød');

    INSERT INTO verbs(word) VALUES
      ('will drink'),
      ('smashes'),
      ('smøkes'),
      ('eats'),
      ('walks tøwards'),
      ('løves'),
      ('helps'),
      ('pushes'),
      ('debugs'),
      ('invites'),
      ('hides'),
      ('will ship');

    INSERT INTO adjectives(word) VALUES
      ('the exquisite'),
      ('a pink'),
      ('the røtten'),
      ('a red'),
      ('the serverless'),
      ('a brøken'),
      ('a shiny'),
      ('the pretty'),
      ('the impressive'),
      ('an awesøme'),
      ('the famøus'),
      ('a gigantic'),
      ('the gløriøus'),
      ('the nørdic'),
      ('the welcøming'),
      ('the deliciøus');
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-pvc
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  serviceName: wordsmith-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-db
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-db
      containers:
        - name: db
          image: postgres:10.0-alpine
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: init-scripts
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            capabilities:
              add:
                - CHOWN
                - FOWNER
                - SETUID
                - SETGID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - postgres
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - postgres
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - postgres
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: init-scripts
          configMap:
            name: wordsmith-db-init
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: db-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-api
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-api
      fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-api
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_HOST
              value: wordsmith-db
            - name: POSTGRES_PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-web
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-web
      fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-web
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: API_HOST
              value: wordsmith-api
            - name: API_PORT
              value: "8080"
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 80
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 80
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
```
